recreation_brief: 1. White background slide. 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#8B0000) rectangular frame around the full slide perimeter. 3. Add title 'K -NN: Some other distance measures' centered near top, bold, dark red (#8B0000), large sans-serif. 4. Top-right: small yellow (#FFFF99) circle with dark outline containing '55' in black. 5. Draw a large rounded-corner rectangle with thin dark-red border occupying roughly the middle 70% of the slide. 6. Inside, left column: bullet 'Binary-valued features' (bold dark red); sub-bullet '- Use Hamming distance:' with 'Hamming' underlined; sub-bullet '- Hamming distance counts the number of features where the two examples disagree'. 7. Next bullet: 'Mixed feature types' (bold dark red) followed by ' (some real-valued and some binary-valued)?' in black; sub-bullets '- Can use mixed distance measures' and '- E.g., Euclidean for the real part, Hamming for the binary part' with 'Euclidean' highlighted yellow (#FFFF00) and 'Hamming' highlighted cyan (#00FFFF). 8. Next bullet: 'Can also assign weights to features:' with 'assign weights to features' in blue (#0000CC) underlined. 9. Right side upper: pale yellow (#FFFFCC) box with thin dark border containing equation d(x_i, x_j) = sum_{m=1}^{D} I(x_im != x_jm). 10. Right side lower: pale yellow box with thin dark border containing d(x_i, x_j) = sum_{m=1}^{D} w_m d(x_im, x_jm). 11. Bottom-left: small faint gray footer text with course attribution.
